heightmap.format: PNG greyscale, 16 bit big-endian samples, not interlaced, filter type 0 on every row

frame: core world frame: x east, y north, z up, sea level z = 0

origin.note: world x, y of the centre of pixel (col 0, row 0), the image's top-left sample

axes.row: south: y_m = origin.y_m - row * pixel_size_m (row 0 is the northern edge)

sampling.integer_coordinates: an integer (col, row) is a pixel centre
sampling.outside: clamp col and row to [0, size - 1]
sampling.seabed: z_m < 0 is the seabed and the water depth is -z_m

start.heading_convention: compass: clockwise from north, 0 = north, 90 = east
start.note: open water south of the harbour mouth, heading in through it

layout.open_sea: south, deepening to about 34 m at the southern edge
layout.inner_bay: x within about +-1500 m, y from about -400 to the beach, 8 to 12 m deep
layout.beach: north shore, x within about +-800 m, shoaling over about 200 to 400 m
